1. Decisions for you: nothing new this cycle. Seven proposed decisions in the group log wait on you. Five are escalations: de6b88c5 (may the group merge a Door 3 revision that only executes a ratified ruling? It holds srs#1033 to #1037 and the srs-rust work behind them), 773ae4a6 (which DOS timestamp a deterministic .srs archive carries: the spec says 0x0000 and also 1980-01-01, which differ; filed 2026-11-20; srs-rust writes date 0x0021), 864eaebf (srs#991: one heading-outline rule for every document, or opt-in per Composition), bc6bc746 (srs-web#691: is editor UI inside this group's mandate?), c7a8e0a2 (srs-rust#1497: may `note delete` refuse notes that Relations point at?). Two are builder proposals: 21b6b4b7 (srs#236: enforce field identity rules in the schema, in a validator, or stop claiming them; 7+ weeks), 6882f577 (structured findings for record and container validate, srs-rust#1339). Action needed: decide or ratify. Urgency: de6b88c5 first. Also waiting for your merge: srs#1033 to #1037 (gate:owner-merge, since 14 Nov).

Needs-input: srs-rust#1495, #1164, #731, #728, srs-web#691 and #632. No red gate reported by a run. Escalation-log check (owner rulings in both logs): not re-read this cycle.

5b. Awaiting ratification: the seven proposed decisions in section 1 (oldest 21b6b4b7, 7+ weeks). Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: ready by label: srs-rust 14, srs 4, srs-vscode 0, srs-web 1. Queue fed for about 1 cycle while paused (6 workable, but the group builds nothing until it is unpaused). Waits on the owner: the seven decisions, five Door 3 merges, the acknowledgement that resumes the group. Fed by the analyst: 2026-11-20, filed 4 conformance issues, asked 1 ruling.

Whether it is useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
